title: World Cup Colour
summary:
Even though games at Toronto Stadium are now finished, and south of the border the tournament is heading into its final matches, several FIFA World Cup installations are still in place around the city. One that adds colour to the ever-popular Harbourfront Centre area is a walk festooned with flags from all 48 qualifying countries, leading people from Queens Quay south to the waterside.
